cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(Axpy3 LANGUAGES CXX CUDA)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CUDA_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CUDA_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
add_library(Axpy3 OBJECT axpy3.cu)
set_target_properties(Axpy3 PROPERTIES CUDA_ARCHITECTURES 86)
target_compile_options(Axpy3 PRIVATE $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:--expt-relaxed-constexpr>)
